sources.quote: Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.
Meccanica Chisone passed the re-audit yesterday, score 86. I set them back to approved.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora was set to conditional on 2026-09-15. No later document restores its standing. The 2026-11-06 review only reinstated Chisone. Dora may not receive new business or parts now.

sources.quote: Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today

findings.why: The ASL entry APR-009 still reads approved with no end date, which is why the proposal says Dora is still on the list. The change board revoked that approval on 2026-09-15, and the 8D confirms it. The ASL record is outdated. HB-620 for Pinerolo and Nordhavn is now released to Fonderia Pellice (APR-011), not to Dora.
